INVITATION FOR BIDS
The Town of Mapleford, acting through its Board of Public Works (the Owner), invites sealed bids for the
Elm Street and Oak Avenue Water Main Replacement, Contract No. W-2026-04, in Mapleford,
Massachusetts.
Sealed bids will be received at the Office of the DPW Director, 40 Center Street, Mapleford, MA until
11:00 AM on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at which time they will be publicly opened and read aloud.
The Work consists of replacing approximately 4,850 linear feet of existing 6-inch cast iron water main on
Elm Street and Oak Avenue with 12-inch and 8-inch ductile iron water main, together with new gate
valves, fire hydrants, water services, temporary water, trench pavement and final paving.
A pre-bid conference will be held at 10:00 AM on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at the DPW Garage, 12
Mill Road, Mapleford. Attendance is not mandatory.
Each bid must be accompanied by bid security in the amount of five percent (5%) of the value of the bid,
in the form of a bid bond, certified check, or treasurer's or cashier's check.

Each bid must be accompanied by bid security in the amount of five percent (5%) of the value of the bid,
in the form of a bid bond, certified check, or treasurer's or cashier's check.
This Contract is subject to M.G.L. Chapter 30, Section 39M and to the Massachusetts prevailing wage
law, M.G.L. Chapter 149, Sections 26 to 27H. The Owner reserves the right to reject any or all bids.

INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS
1. Bids shall be submitted on the Bid Form furnished in these Contract Documents. Unit prices shall be
written in both words and figures. In case of a discrepancy, the unit price written in words governs.
2. Addenda will be issued to all plan holders of record. Each Bidder shall acknowledge all addenda on the
Bid Form.
3. Award will be made to the lowest responsible and eligible bidder on the basis of the Total Base Bid.
The Owner may award any or all Bid Alternates.

SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL BID - Mapleford Contract W-2026-04
Page 5
INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS (continued)
4. The successful Bidder shall furnish a performance bond and a labor and materials payment bond, each
in the amount of one hundred percent (100%) of the Contract Price, issued by a surety licensed in
Massachusetts.
5. Bidders shall examine the site and the Contract Documents. Quantities shown on the Bid Form are
estimates for comparing bids only; payment will be made for actual quantities installed.

AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made between the Town of Mapleford (the Owner) and the Contractor named below
for the Elm Street and Oak Avenue Water Main Replacement. The Contractor shall complete the Work in
accordance with the Contract Documents for the unit prices stated in the Bid Form.

SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL BID - Mapleford Contract W-2026-04
Page 10
GENERAL CONDITIONS
The Contractor shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment and services necessary to complete the Work
in accordance with the Contract Documents. The Engineer shall decide all questions about the quality and
acceptability of materials furnished and work performed. The Contractor shall keep on the site a
competent superintendent during the progress of the Work. Shop drawings shall be submitted in time to
allow review without delay to the Work. The Contractor shall protect all existing improvements and restore
any damage at no additional cost to the Owner.
Differing site conditions: if the Contractor finds subsurface conditions at the site materially different from
those shown in the Contract Documents, the Contractor shall notify the Engineer in writing before
disturbing them, and an equitable adjustment may be made.

SUPPLEMENTARY CONDITIONS
SC-1 Contract Time. The Contractor shall substantially complete the Work within two hundred ten (210)
consecutive calendar days from the date of the Notice to Proceed.
SC-2 Liquidated Damages. For each calendar day that the Work remains incomplete after the Contract
Time, the Contractor shall pay the Owner liquidated damages of One Thousand Five Hundred Dollars
($1,500.00) per calendar day.
SC-3 Retainage. The Owner will retain five percent (5%) of each progress payment until substantial
completion.
SC-4 Working Hours. Work shall be performed between 7:00 AM and 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
No work is allowed on weekends or legal holidays without written approval of the Owner.

SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL BID - Mapleford Contract W-2026-04
Page 13
SUPPLEMENTARY CONDITIONS (continued)
SC-5 Night Work. Work within the Route 110 intersection shall be performed at night between 9:00 PM
and 5:00 AM. Only one lane of Route 110 may be closed at any time.
SC-6 Police Details. Uniformed police officers are required for all work within public ways. Police details
will be paid under the Police Details allowance item.
SC-7 Paving Season. No permanent trench pavement shall be placed after November 15 or before April
15 without the written approval of the Engineer.
SC-8 Subsurface Conditions. The Contractor shall make its own investigation of subsurface conditions.
No claim for additional compensation will be allowed for rock, ledge or boulders encountered in the
trench.

SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL BID - Mapleford Contract W-2026-04
Page 14
SUPPLEMENTARY CONDITIONS (continued)
SC-9 Insurance. In addition to the limits in the General Conditions, the Contractor shall carry umbrella
liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000 per occurrence, naming the Town of Mapleford as an
additional insured.
SC-10 Utilities. The locations of existing utilities shown on the Drawings are approximate. The Contractor
shall excavate test pits to locate utilities before laying pipe.

PREVAILING WAGE RATES
The Massachusetts prevailing wage rate schedule issued for this project applies to all work. The
Contractor shall submit certified weekly payrolls to the Owner. Apprentices must be registered with the
Division of Apprentice Standards.

SECTION 31 23 00 - EXCAVATION AND FILL
1.01 Rock Excavation. Rock excavation is paid at the unit price bid for Item 15, measured in cubic yards
within the pay limits shown on the Drawings.
1.02 Dewatering. Groundwater is expected near Station 12+00 to 18+00. The Contractor shall keep
excavations free of water and shall discharge only through a sediment control device.
1.03 Compaction. Trench backfill shall be compacted to at least 95 percent of maximum dry density. The
Contractor shall pay for one compaction test for every 200 linear feet of trench.

SECTION 33 11 00 - WATER UTILITY DISTRIBUTION PIPING
3.01 Pressure Test. Each section of new main shall be pressure tested at 150 psi for two (2) hours.
Leakage shall not exceed the allowable amount in AWWA C600.
3.02 Disinfection. New mains shall be disinfected in accordance with AWWA C651. Two consecutive sets
of bacteriological samples taken 24 hours apart must pass before the main is placed in service.
3.03 Ductile iron pipe shall be Class 52, cement lined, with push-on joints, conforming to AWWA C151.

1.01 Soil testing at three locations on Oak Avenue found petroleum compounds above reportable

facility. Disposal is paid under the allowance in Item 18.
